title: Designer Time Billing for Design Studio Selections Consultation Fees
content:
**Rule.** The billed fee count of a design consultation fee on a Design Studio Selections file is set by the designer hours the billed appointment used:

- an appointment that ran longer than the package's appointment hours is billed one fee for every started block of the package's appointment hours: the hours used divided by the package's appointment hours, rounded up to a whole number;
- an appointment that used half of the package's appointment hours or less is billed 0.5 of a fee (one half);
- any other appointment is billed one fee.

The hours used are those shown on the billed appointment's entry on the design ledger.

**Package appointment hours and the half-hours line**

| Package | Appointment hours | Half of the appointment hours |
|---|---|---|
| Studio Essentials | 2.0 | 1.0 |
| Studio Classic | 3.0 | 1.5 |
| Studio Select | 3.0 | 1.5 |
| Studio Designer | 4.0 | 2.0 |
| Studio Signature | 4.0 | 2.0 |
| Studio Atelier | 6.0 | 3.0 |

**Worked hours** (hypothetical appointments on a package of 4.0 appointment hours)

| Hours used | Reading | Billed fee count |
|---|---|---|
| 1.5 | Half the hours or less | 0.5 |
| 2.0 | Exactly half: half or less | 0.5 |
| 2.5 | More than half, not longer than 4.0 | 1 |
| 4.0 | Not longer than 4.0 | 1 |
| 4.5 | Longer: 4.5 divided by 4.0 is 1.125, rounded up | 2 |
| 9.0 | Longer: 9.0 divided by 4.0 is 2.25, rounded up | 3 |
